headline: 零食國安危機！會議桌淪陷
ticker: 同事魔手越界｜玉米脆餅失守｜全國抽屜戒嚴
anchor_script: 緊急插播！一場例行會議，竟爆發零食主權危機！苦主才低頭找筆，同事魔手已三度越界！一口接一口，玉米脆餅慘遭清空！更扯的是，嫌疑人邊嚼邊點頭，企圖把咀嚼偽裝成支持提案！現在桌面拉起封鎖線，最後一顆脆餅由湯匙護送！這究竟是嘴饞，還是辦公室糧食政變？本台持續緊盯！
cast: The snack owner is a 28-year-old woman with a straight black bob wearing a yellow cardigan, white blouse, and navy trousers, and the snack-stealing coworker is a 32-year-old man with short black hair wearing a gray shirt and black trousers.

shots.scene_en: In a plain meeting room, the snack owner bends down to retrieve a pen while the snack-stealing coworker reaches toward her unmarked bowl of corn puffs, shown in a wide establishing shot with no text, letters, or logos visible.

At the meeting table, the snack-stealing coworker stretches his arm theatrically across three parallel rows of pencils to snatch corn puffs while the snack owner remains bent down, shown in an overhead close-up with no text, letters, or logos visible.

In the meeting room, the snack-stealing coworker nods solemnly with puffed cheeks while the snack owner stares at her nearly empty bowl in disbelief, shown in an eye-level two-shot with no text, letters, or logos visible.

At the meeting table, the snack owner stretches plain red ribbon between empty cups around the bowl while the snack-stealing coworker recoils with both hands raised, shown from a low dramatic angle with no text, letters, or logos visible.

In the meeting room, the snack owner solemnly carries the final corn puff on a spoon toward an open drawer while the snack-stealing coworker kneels beside the table with clasped hands, shown in a dramatic side-angle tracking shot with no text, letters, or logos visible.
